mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_logs (log_level, log_content, create_time, class_name, method_name, request_url, username, ip) VALUES (#{logLevel}, #{logContent}, #{createTime}, #{className}, #{methodName}, #{requestUrl}, #{username}, #{ip})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_logs ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM sys_logs WHERE log_level = #{logLevel} ORDER BY create_time DESC
